verdict.rationale: sevDesk is accounting and invoicing SaaS, not an AI agent or assistant that would act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it to use their tools is the wrong axis for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows sevDesk ships an agent that consumes external tools. Its REST API and partner integrations are a different capability and are not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
